meta.title: How FamCal Works — Setup in 2 Minutes
meta.description: See how FamCal turns your family’s Google Calendars into a daily voice and text briefing on Telegram. Connect, label, and start getting organized.

howItWorksPage.heroSubtitle: From zero to your first family briefing in under 2 minutes

step1.title: Start the bot on Telegram
step1.description: Open @family_calendar_telegram_bot on Telegram and tap Start. That’s it — your account is created automatically. The bot detects your language and greets you in Hebrew, English, or Russian.

step2.title: Connect your Google Calendar
step2.description: Tap ‘Open Dashboard’ and sign in with Google. FamCal gets read and write access to your calendars. Your tokens are stored encrypted — we never see your Google password.
step2.note: Takes about 30 seconds. Standard Google OAuth — same as any app you’ve connected before.

step3.title: Label your calendars
step3.description: Pick which calendars to track and label them: mine, spouse, kids, work, holidays. Give your spouse’s calendar a name so summaries say ‘Maya has…’ instead of ‘Event on calendar 3.’ You can set custom AI rules per calendar too.

summary.title: Morning summary arrives
summary.description: At the time you choose, FamCal sends your family’s complete daily schedule to Telegram. Text + voice.

merged.title: Everyone’s schedule, merged
merged.description: Your events, spouse’s events, each kid’s schedule — labeled and organized. No more switching between 7 calendars.

pickup.title: Pickup order, sorted
pickup.description: Kids’ events sorted by end time. You always know who finishes first and where to go.

weather.title: Weather that matters
weather.description: Not just a forecast — weather warnings tied to your actual schedule. ‘Rain at 15:00, bring umbrellas for pickup.’

voice.title: Voice commands
voice.description: Need to add an event? Send a voice note. ‘Add dentist appointment for Thursday at 10.’ FamCal handles the rest — including recurring events.

insights.title: AI insights
insights.description: FamCal spots conflicts, gaps, and logistics issues before they become problems. ‘You have back-to-back events at different locations at 14:00.’

noNeed: No app to install — everything is in Telegram
No new calendar to maintain — FamCal reads your existing Google Calendar

googleCopy.title: Copy to Google

notes.oneWay: Copies go one way: changes made in Google are replaced by the next change in FamCal.
notes.alerts: Alerts come from FamCal, not from the Google copy.
notes.hebrew: Events that repeat by the Hebrew date show in Google as one event per year for the next 10 Hebrew years, with the year count in the title. Copies made earlier switch to this on the next sync.
